_comment: Skill Repo Spec v1 s9 -- every path in this repo belongs to exactly one class.
TOOL    = code, SKILL.md, docs, reference data, and metrics ABOUT THE SKILL. Public.
FIXTURE = LIFELIKE test data: rows that look like real records, whose real version is
sitting right there in the operator's life and is structurally indistinguishable.
Must be produced by tools/make_fixtures.py -- a real record cannot be regenerated,
so pasting one in fails at commit. (A self-evidently fake canary or an Acme mock is
NOT lifelike and does not need a generator; the risk it guards against is a person
reaching for a convenient REAL example, and there is no temptation to reach for a
real value that would look obviously wrong next to FAKE_CANARY_XYZ.)
DATA    = anything a REAL RUN produced. Never git-tracked. Lives in the private companion
config, resolved at runtime by tools/datadir.py. This repo ships only the schema.
data_sealed = a path that HELD real data, was purged, and must stay dead.
Enforced by tools/data_boundary.py in .githooks and in CI.
_audited: 2026-07-31 RE-AUDIT (supersedes the 2026-07-13 sweep, which recorded an empty declaration for this repo). The earlier sweep asked only whether shipped code appends to a TRACKED file here. That question is too narrow: it clears every path that is gitignored, and .gitignore is advisory -- `git add -f` walks straight through it, which is the whole reason declarations exist. This pass asked instead whether shipped code or shipped docs can put REAL-RUN OUTPUT at a repo-relative path at all. ANSWER: YES. This skill writes its evolution runs -- proposals, diffs, judge verdicts, probe transcripts, per-round state -- into <target>/.sie/runs/, and one of the targets it is routinely pointed at is THIS repo. tools/sie/state.py, archive.py and profile.py all write under a run dir derived from the target path, and cli.py builds it as <target>/.sie/runs. This repo's .gitignore lists .sie/, runs/, logs/, _run/, .nightrun/ and examples/btarget/.sie/ for exactly that reason, and was the only thing standing between those transcripts and `git add -f`. All six are directory-form, so no .example is owed. NOTE for whoever reads this next: every other repo in the fleet gitignores .sie/ too, for the same reason, and none of them declares it. That is a real gap, and it is a per-repo audit rather than a blanket edit, so it is recorded here instead of being applied silently everywhere.
_data_home: ~/.self-evolve-config/data/   (override with $SELF_EVOLVE_DATA_DIR). If this skill ever needs to record real-run output, it goes THERE -- never back into this repo.
